10th September – Speaker Meeting – Display of beautifully made handcrafted products – NGO: Srujna Charitable Trust

On 10th September, during the speaker meeting at The Runwal Reserve, beautifully made handcrafted products of Srujna Charitable Trust were displayed.
A Letter of Appreciation was received from them, “On behalf of Srujna Charitable Trust, we sincerely thank you for giving our women an opportunity to showcase their beautifully handcrafted products at the exhibition held on 10th September at The Reserve Banquet, Worli. We are happy to share that our women achieved sales of ₹12,800 during the exhibition. More importantly, the opportunity provided them with valuable exposure and encouragement to showcase their skills and products. We truly appreciate your support in creating meaningful platforms and market opportunities for women”.
